description:
• About our brand and products:

ZTW Model is a leading manufacturer specializing in high-performance Brushless Electronic Speed Controllers (ESC) and motors for RC enthusiasts worldwide. With over 15 years of industry experience, we provide a full range of reliable power solutions for RC Airplanes, Helicopters, Cars, and Boats. From the entry-level Beatles series to the professional-grade Skyhawk and the waterproof Seal series, our products are engineered for precision, efficiency, and durability in the most demanding hobbyist environments.

• What makes us different:

  • Direct Manufacturer: We are not just a reseller. We design, manufacture, and test our ESCs in-house, ensuring top-tier quality control and competitive factory-direct pricing.

  • Technological Innovation: Our ESCs support the latest protocols (BLHeli_32, DShot) and feature advanced thermal management and programmable parameters that pro-racers and hobbyists demand.

  • Versatile Product Line: Whether it’s 150A waterproof marine ESCs or ultra-lightweight FPV controllers, we cover every segment of the RC market.

  • Global Reputation: ZTW is a trusted name in the RC community, known for "Bulletproof" reliability and excellent power-to-weight ratios.

• How affiliates can earn:

  • 10% Base Commission: Earn a 10% commission on every successful referral sale generated through your link or coupon.

  • High Average Order Value (AOV): RC setups often require multiple units or high-end ESCs, leading to significant commission per sale.

  • 30-Day Cookie Window: You get credit for any purchase made within 30 days of the initial click.

  • Performance Bonuses: Top-performing affiliates are eligible for higher commission tiers (up to 15%) and exclusive monthly bonuses.

• How to promote us:

  • Build Logs & Tutorials: Share your RC assembly process on forums (like RCGroups) or YouTube and link to the ZTW components you use.

  • Performance Testing: Create "Thrust Tests" or "Speed Runs" videos showing ZTW ESCs in action.

  • Social Media Reviews: Post high-quality photos of your RC rigs equipped with ZTW gear on Instagram and TikTok using your unique discount code.

  • Blog/Tech Articles: Write about ESC calibration, firmware updates, or "Best ESCs for 2026" guides.

• Other information:

  • Dedicated Support: We provide our affiliates with high-res images, technical wiring diagrams, and promotional banners.

  • Exclusive Samples: High-traffic influencers and active reviewers may apply for free product samples for new launches.

  • Reliable Tracking: Powered by UpPromote, ensuring transparent, real-time tracking and on-time monthly payouts.
